lesson.title: Wonder as Inspiration
lesson.topic: How wonder can inspire innovation and creative problem-solving in everyday life.
lesson.steelman: What are the most powerful ways that cultivating a sense of wonder has led to significant breakthroughs or innovations?
lesson.example: The curiosity-driven exploration that led to the discovery of penicillin by Alexander Fleming.

rationale: This lesson emphasizes how wonder can fuel creativity and innovation, making it a critical component for antifragility in personal growth.
